intro: Make every meal more inviting with the Leon dining chairs. Their cushioned seat and tall backrest keep you comfortable, while the frame and fabric add a touch of timeless style to your space.

features.title: Comfort that lasts through meals
features.text: Soft foam cushioning and a supportive seat keep you relaxed, so family dinners or long conversations always feel enjoyable and unhurried.

features.title: High backrest for better support
features.text: A tall, full-back design gives your posture the right support, making it easier for you to sit comfortably during long hours at the table.

features.title: Durable solid wood frame
features.text: Crafted from strong rubber wood in a walnut finish, the frame gives you lasting stability while adding warmth to your dining space.

features.title: Elegant ash fabric upholstery
features.text: The seat and back are upholstered in ash-shaded polyester fabric, blending sophistication with durability for everyday dining use.

features.title: Curved design with smooth edges
features.text: Rounded edges and a curvilinear profile enhance safety and style, giving your dining area a polished, modern look.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
